question: What are the top 10 products by total revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10

question: Which product categories generate the most revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name AS category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.id = p.category_id JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10

question: How many orders were placed each month this year?
gold_sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE YEAR(created_at) = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY month ORDER BY month LIMIT 12

question: Who are the top 10 customers by total spend?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_spend FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY total_spend DESC LIMIT 10

question: What is the average order value?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(order_total) AS avg_order_value FROM (SELECT o.id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS order_total FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id GROUP BY o.id) sub LIMIT 1

question: What percentage of orders are completed vs pending?
gold_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS percentage FROM orders GROUP BY status LIMIT 20

question: What is the total revenue by month for the last 6 months?
gold_sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.created_at, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH) GROUP BY month ORDER BY month LIMIT 6

question: Which customers have not placed any orders?
gold_sql: SELECT c.id, c.name, c.email FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.id IS NULL LIMIT 50

question: What is the most popular product by number of units sold?
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 10

question: What is the average number of items per order?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(item_count) AS avg_items_per_order FROM (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity) AS item_count FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) sub LIMIT 1

question: Which products have never been sold?
gold_sql: SELECT p.id, p.name FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE oi.id IS NULL LIMIT 50

question: How many new customers signed up each month?
gold_sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS new_customers FROM customers GROUP BY month ORDER BY month LIMIT 24

question: What is the revenue contribution of each category as a percentage of total?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) * 100.0 / SUM(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price)) OVER (), 2) AS pct FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.id = p.category_id JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 20

question: What is the total revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS total_revenue FROM order_items LIMIT 1

question: Which day of the week has the most orders?
gold_sql: SELECT DAYNAME(created_at) AS day_of_week, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY DAYOFWEEK(created_at), day_of_week ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 7

question: What is the repeat purchase rate?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN order_count > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS repeat_rate FROM (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id) sub LIMIT 1

question: What is the average revenue per customer?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id), 2) AS avg_revenue_per_customer FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id LIMIT 1

question: Which products have the highest average unit price?
gold_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 10

question: What is the total number of orders?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM orders LIMIT 1

question: What is the total number of customers?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_customers FROM customers LIMIT 1

question: Which category has the most products?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(p.id) AS product_count FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY product_count DESC LIMIT 10

question: What is the average order value by customer segment?
gold_sql: SELECT c.segment, AVG(order_total) AS avg_order_value FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS order_total FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) oi ON o.id = oi.order_id GROUP BY c.segment LIMIT 20

question: How many products are in each category?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(p.id) AS product_count FROM categories c LEFT JOIN products p ON c.id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY product_count DESC LIMIT 20

question: What is the revenue trend over the past 12 months?
gold_sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.created_at, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 12 MONTH) GROUP BY month ORDER BY month LIMIT 12

question: Who placed the largest single order?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, o.id AS order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS order_total FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id GROUP BY o.id, c.name ORDER BY order_total DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the distribution of order values?
gold_sql: SELECT MIN(order_total) AS min_value, MAX(order_total) AS max_value, AVG(order_total) AS avg_value, COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS order_total FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) sub LIMIT 1

question: Which products were ordered together most often?
gold_sql: SELECT p1.name AS product_1, p2.name AS product_2, COUNT(*) AS co_occurrences FROM order_items oi1 JOIN order_items oi2 ON oi1.order_id = oi2.order_id AND oi1.product_id < oi2.product_id JOIN products p1 ON oi1.product_id = p1.id JOIN products p2 ON oi2.product_id = p2.id GROUP BY p1.id, p2.id, p1.name, p2.name ORDER BY co_occurrences DESC LIMIT 10

question: What is the customer lifetime value for the top 10 customers?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS lifetime_value, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS total_orders FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY lifetime_value DESC LIMIT 10

question: What is the month-over-month revenue growth rate?
gold_sql: SELECT month, revenue, LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_revenue, ROUND((revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)) * 100.0 / LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS growth_pct FROM (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.created_at, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id GROUP BY month) sub ORDER BY month LIMIT 24

question: Which orders are still pending after more than 7 days?
gold_sql: SELECT id, customer_id, created_at, DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), created_at) AS days_pending FROM orders WHERE status = 'pending' AND created_at < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) ORDER BY days_pending DESC LIMIT 50

question: What percentage of products have been ordered at least once?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT p.id), 2) AS pct_products_ordered FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id LIMIT 1

question: What is the total quantity sold per product?
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 20

question: How many distinct products were ordered this month?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) AS distinct_products FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE MONTH(o.created_at) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(o.created_at) = YEAR(CURDATE()) LIMIT 1

question: Which customers made their first purchase in the last 30 days?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, MIN(o.created_at) AS first_order_date FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name HAVING MIN(o.created_at) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) ORDER BY first_order_date DESC LIMIT 50

question: What is the average time between orders for returning customers?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(days_diff) AS avg_days_between_orders FROM (SELECT customer_id, DATEDIFF(created_at, LAG(created_at) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY created_at)) AS days_diff FROM orders) sub WHERE days_diff IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1

question: What is the total number of products?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_products FROM products LIMIT 1

question: Which payment methods are most commonly used?
gold_sql: SELECT payment_method, COUNT(*) AS count FROM payments GROUP BY payment_method ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10

question: What is the total revenue from completed orders only?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS completed_revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' LIMIT 1

question: What is the highest selling product in each category?
gold_sql: SELECT category, product_name, revenue FROM (SELECT c.name AS category, p.name AS product_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) DESC) AS rn FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.id = p.category_id JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name, p.id, p.name) ranked WHERE rn = 1 LIMIT 20

question: What is the average product price by category?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name AS category, ROUND(AVG(p.price), 2) AS avg_price FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY avg_price DESC LIMIT 20

question: How many orders were placed today?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_today FROM orders WHERE DATE(created_at) = CURDATE() LIMIT 1

question: What is the refund rate?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'refunded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS refund_rate FROM orders LIMIT 1

question: Which customers have the most orders?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 10

question: What is the average time to fulfill an order (from creation to completion)?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(DATEDIFF(updated_at, created_at)) AS avg_fulfillment_days FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' LIMIT 1

question: What is the weekly order volume for the past 4 weeks?
gold_sql: SELECT WEEK(created_at) AS week_number, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 4 WEEK) GROUP BY WEEK(created_at) ORDER BY week_number LIMIT 4

question: Which products have a price above the average price?
gold_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE price > (SELECT AVG(price) FROM products) ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 50

question: How many orders contain more than 5 items?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_with_5plus_items FROM (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity) AS total_items FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id HAVING total_items > 5) sub LIMIT 1

question: What is the total discount given across all orders?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(discount_amount) AS total_discount FROM orders WHERE discount_amount IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1

question: Which products were ordered in the last 7 days?
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, COUNT(oi.id) AS order_count FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 20

question: What are the top 5 best-selling products this quarter?
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS quarterly_revenue FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.created_at >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') - INTERVAL (MONTH(CURDATE()) - 1) % 3 MONTH GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY quarterly_revenue DESC LIMIT 5
